detail: Full summary: a v3 handoff guard written into two shell hooks through a Python heredoc used shell single-quote escaping, so the grep pattern contained literal quote marks and never matched; review-by-reading passed it because the escaping looks correct for a different writer. Lesson recorded: a test that flips a gap must exercise the path the OLD behaviour lived on (the legacy hooks), not only the new hook; test/hooks/legacy-v3-handoff.test.ts now does (red before, green after).
